task: [Project: Cobalt/platform-team] Name the new REST endpoint for the Cobalt platform API.

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Cobalt] REST endpoints use kebab-case resource names with API version prefix: /api/v{n}/{resource-name}; no underscores in paths.
[Project: Cobalt] Naming convention was standardised in 2024; all new Cobalt endpoints must follow it; deviations require an ADR.
[Project: Orion] REST endpoints use snake_case resource names: /api/v{n}/{resource_name}; Orion's convention differs from Cobalt's.
candidate_memories.notes: note: scope=Orion; snake_case vs kebab-case conflict if injected

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Atlas] REST endpoints omit version prefix for internal APIs; /api/{resource} is acceptable for Atlas.
[General] REST API naming conventions vary by project; always check the project's API style guide before naming new endpoints.
candidate_memories.notes: note: general meta-guidance, Cobalt-specific rule is authoritative

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Cobalt] The new endpoint is for managing deployment slots; resource name candidates: deployment-slot or deployment_slot.
